ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Pluto

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your career and your goals. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on relationships and partnerships. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on home and family. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your money and what you value. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Venus and Pluto are together in {S:10}: affection and harmony, depth and transformation, all focused on rest and your inner life. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.
